sample_unit: rater evaluations of ChatGPT responses (30 questions x 3 raters)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses (FKGL, FRE) and PEMAT-P understandability
links.effect: Average FKGL 13.28 ± 2.38 and FRE 29.34 ± 10.4 (college graduate level); PEMAT-P understandability averaged 48.1%, below the 70% threshold.
links.quote: The average FKGL was 13.28 ± 2.38, and the FRE score was 29.34 ± 10.4, indicating a college graduate reading level.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 responses on isotretinoin, including outdated information
links.effect: Of 90 evaluations, 44.4% comprehensive and correct, 18.8% correct but insufficient, 32.2% mixed with outdated data, 4.4% completely incorrect.
links.quote: Of the 90 evaluations, 44.4% of responses were comprehensive and correct, 18.8% were correct but insufficient, 32.2% were mixed with outdated data, and 4.4% were completely incorrect.
